gate_type: IMPLEMENTATION gate — SH-WTP Federated Evaluation Trace & Diagnostics (G15)
objective: Create the smallest deterministic evaluation/diagnostic layer over the accepted G14B ShwtpFederation (T106 -> REL-SHW-F01 -> T108, explicit_lagged). Run a bounded number (window_count >= 1) of existing federation windows sequentially, capture one immutable/detached evaluation row per completed window (window_id, window_index, start/end time, communication_step_s, run_id, coupling_policy, T106 input/output-staged, T108 inflow-used/committed-next/requested/applied outflow, start/end volume, end level, overflow, mass-balance residual, provenance/fidelity/status refs), expose lag_windows=1 evaluation metadata (NOT a CompositionGraph property), compute an exact accepted-model mass-balance residual (residual = V_end - (V_start + Qin_used*dt - Qout_applied*dt - overflow); exactly 0.0 — no invented global tolerance; fail closed on any violation), and produce a deterministic immutable summary (run_id, window_count, start/end time, communication step, coupling policy, lag_windows, initial/final + min/max T108 volume, initial/final level, total T106 staged volume, total T108 inflow-used volume, total applied outflow volume, total overflow volume, max absolute mass-balance residual) derived only from actual trace/runtime outputs. Failed windows fail closed (no retry/rollback/skip/hide). No scheduler/profile engine, no variable per-window scenario inputs, constant G14B scenario values only. Preserve provenance (T106 simulation/synthetic/logical_only; T108 simulation/synthetic/first_order). No measured/site/calibrated/plant truth.
explicit_non_objectives: No modification of G4 Coordinator / ExecutableParticipant semantics
No modification of T106/T108 equations or standalone behavior
No modification of G14A projection identities
No modification of explicit_lagged semantics / G14B-C01 identity locking
No modification of G7 run control / PIM
No variable-window scenario scheduler or profile engine
No new global numeric tolerance policy
forbidden_actions: Change T106/T108 equations, canonical ids, or provenance
Change G4 Coordinator / ExecutableParticipant / BoundaryTransfer semantics
Change G14A projection or F01 binding
Change explicit_lagged semantics or G14B-C01 identity locking
Change PIM or G7 run control
Invent a global numeric tolerance policy
Implement variable per-window scenario inputs / scheduler / profile engine
Claim measured/site/calibrated truth in evaluation output
stop_conditions: Evaluation requires changing T106/T108 domain equations
Evaluation requires changing G4 or coupling semantics
Exact mass-balance verification cannot be done without defining a new numeric tolerance policy
Variable per-window scenario semantics are required
A new global telemetry/analytics architecture must be invented
Any site/plant KPI or site-truth interpretation is required

acceptance_criteria.description: Exactly one immutable trace row per completed window; contiguous window numbering; failed windows not recorded as success
Trace row captures all required fields from actual T106/T108 runtime steps incl. mass-balance residual (exact zero) and provenance/fidelity/status refs
Deterministic trace + summary serialization; fresh attempts isolated
explicit_lagged visible; lag_windows=1 evaluation metadata (not on CompositionGraph); first-window uses initial inflow; second window uses previous output
Exact run/window/time identity; window_count >= 1 enforced; failed outcome fails closed
Summary totals/min/max derive exactly from trace; max abs mass-balance residual 0.0
Four synthetic evaluation cases (balanced, fill, drain, overflow) pass with exact mass accounting
Provenance truthful (logical_only/first_order synthetic simulation); authority unchanged; no T106/T108/G4/projection mutation
Complete canonical vNext baseline + G14B-C01/G14B/G14A/G13B/G13/G12C/B/A/G11/G10/G9/G7/G4/G2/G1/ASSY/continuous/UI/full suite green
Working tree clean and branch/head pushed
